If the Current Auction is undersubscribed and settles at the Auction Reserve Price, that Reserve Price is used as the Settlement Price for resolution purposes.

If Joint Auction Number 48 is cancelled, postponed, or the Joint Auction Summary Results Report is not published in the time period ending Sep 30, 2026, the market resolves to No.

If CARB reports the price solely in Canadian dollars, it is converted to USD using the Auction Exchange Rate published by CARB for Joint Auction Number 48.
